headline: CDU Sachsen-Anhalt resets: Schulze won’t re-run; Sepp Müller bids for Landesvorsitz after Merz rebuke. Autistici/Inventati shuts down; Kyiv drones resume; Mistral raises €3B.

stories.title: CDU Sachsen-Anhalt: Schulze out of Landesvorsitz race; Sepp Müller runs
facts: n-tv (~21:03 Mon): after Landesvorstand in Magdeburg, MdB Sepp Müller — Fraktionsvize — says “Ich kandidiere als Landesvorsitzender.”
Schulze: whole Landesvorstand up for re-election late Nov / early Dec; re-running as Landeschef “nicht sein Plan.” GenSek Kaschunke also stepping aside (MDR).
Hours earlier Merz publicly rebuked (without naming) a Fraktionsvize for undercutting Spitzenkandidat Schulze pre-election; Müller replies he “teilt die Äußerung … nicht” (SZ/dpa).
Context: CDU 17.2% (from 37.1%), 15 seats (from 40); Schulze: “keinen Regierungsauftrag mehr … Opposition”; Regierungsauftrag “liegt jetzt bei der AfD.”
Evening already had Merz’s shock/no-quit line — overnight is the Land reset + open power fight.
stories.whyItMatters: Magdeburg’s Brandmauer math is still unsettled; overnight the CDU’s own leadership vacuum becomes the story — Müller vs. Merz’s rebuke while AfD hunts a majority.

image.alt: CDU Sachsen-Anhalt state board meeting after the election defeat

stories.title: Hacktivist host Autistici/Inventati shuts down after US “terror” label
facts: heise (Tue ~08:01 Berlin): <2 weeks after the Trump admin designated Italian collective Autistici/Inventati (A/I) a global terrorist org, A/I says it’s closing all services.
State Dept claimed A/I ran infra for “violent Antifa cells”; A/I rejects that — “Antifaschismus und Antikapitalismus ist kein Terrorismus.”
Scale cited by State: ~16k mail accounts, 1.5k sites, 5.5k lists, 10k blogs (+ video/streaming); NoBlogs.org among casualties.
Bank account already frozen; weekend note: continuing would risk legal/financial harm to people near them — “Jetzt schaltet eure PCs aus…”
stories.whyItMatters: A 25-year European non-commercial privacy host is gone overnight because a US designation hit payments and legal exposure — a hard signal for other activist infra.

image.alt: Illustration of a laptop with a padlock symbolizing locked-down activist hosting

stories.title: Kyiv: drones resume after three-day pause for US mediators
facts: SPIEGEL (~03:45 Tue): after Putin’s 3-day strike pause tied to Kushner/Witkoff talks, Russia resumed drone attacks on/near Kyiv once the US party left.
Ukraine emergency service (Telegram, late Mon): drones hit Boryspil and Fastiv districts; two residential buildings damaged; air-raid alert in the capital.
TASS had confirmed the pause expired. Witkoff on Mon called Moscow/Kyiv talks “successful” and floated possible trilateral follow-ups.
stories.whyItMatters: The pause was diplomatic theater timed to the envoys — overnight fire resumes the baseline, not a ceasefire.

image.alt: People sheltering in a Kyiv metro station during an air-raid alert

stories.title: Mistral raises €3B Series D at >€21B — Samsung leads
facts: Mistral: €3B Series D, post-money >€21B — “largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company,” three years after launch.
Samsung Electronics led; co-leads Scaleup Europe Fund (EQT) + existing PSG Equity. New: Advent, BlackRock accounts, Luxembourg; ASML/a16z/NVIDIA et al. re-up.
Use of proceeds: frontier research, training compute, infra, commercial/international expansion (claims 20 countries, 125+ enterprises incl. Airbus, ASML, HSBC).
Pitch: full-stack “sovereign” open-weight AI — models + infra/compute + products, data staying inside customer walls.
stories.whyItMatters: Europe’s open-weight champion just got industrial-scale capital from Samsung/ASML-class backers — the sovereignty bet is now a balance-sheet story.

stories.title: Intel: 1M wafers exposed with High-NA EUV (incl. Panther Lake)
facts: heise (SPIE Photomask/EUV): Intel Foundry says it has exposed >1M wafers on High-NA EUV — from early certification through research to volume for Core Ultra 300 / Panther Lake.
Intel is currently the only foundry using High-NA in series production; ASML Twinscan EXE:5200B costs ≥€350M (~2× Low-NA).
18A compute die: most via Low-NA multi-patterning; a portion in Oregon on High-NA (skips some multi-patterning).
High-NA NA 0.33→0.55, resolution ~13.5→9 nm; reticle field halves to 26×16.5 mm — Intel researching stitching + future 6×12" masks. TSMC still aiming High-NA ~2030.
stories.whyItMatters: High-NA left the slide deck: Intel is already counting production wafers while rivals stay on Low-NA longer.
